command: set -euo pipefail; ADB=adb; SERIAL=$($ADB devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); test -n "$SERIAL"; test "$($ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')" = 'SM-S906B'; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; sleep 2; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof io.blueeye >/dev/null; echo APP_RESTORED_PASS
